review_basis: Frozen report input (set frozen 2026-10-06, before the live-3 and live-4 iterations, never inspected until this single terminal run), grounded element statements, formal plan, deterministic P/I/V AST, validation output and solver output. Z3 success was not treated as semantic correctness. A same-model heterogeneous-prompt dual review (DUAL_REVIEW.json) ran as a second opinion.

rating_scale.pass: faithful to the report and correctly scoped
rating_scale.partial: core direction is correct but a material condition, scope or observable relation is weakened or omitted
rating_scale.fail: misclassified, contradicted, circular or missing a critical report condition
rating_scale.not_evaluable: the pipeline did not emit the corresponding final artifact

summary.element_P_defects: SukukFi: the requirement-comment statement ('Contract must not be paused') was admitted as a precondition instead of grounding I
summary.faithful_outcome_accounting: 6/10 strict formula all-pass; +2 solver consistency catches of defective formalizations (correct behavior, defects caught not emitted) = 8/10 faithful outcomes; 2 visible defects passed through as candidates (GTE_Perps duplicate predicate, SukukFi documentation requirement in P) — both exposed by the report-only identical_p_predicates and review channels, neither silently accepted as truth
summary.iteration_disclosure: Prompt was iterated in place 4 times on blind batches before this terminal run (semantic-live-1 .. live-4, 2026-10-06..07) plus one pre-registered gate fix (hex literal scanner, applied after live-4 met its pre-declared >=2-case threshold). This holdout was frozen before live-3/live-4 and none of its cases informed any change. The stop rule (max 2 further rounds after live-2) was honored: live-4 was the final round.
summary.dual_review_convergence: Both reviews independently flag the same core defect shapes: GTE_Perps and Panoptic__Next_Core predicate collapse. The dual review is systematically stricter on applicability-scope narrowing (Intuition, Olas, SukukFi rated partial there); the primary review rates those pass with the narrowing recorded in unresolved/limitations. No case is rated fail by either review.

Covenant_d4uY8y2AMSs.notes: Temporal validity on sequencer outage: three distinct grounded P booleans; I = (sequencer down, quote within heartbeat, no gate) implies the stale quote is not accepted; V = the stale valuation. The relation is a free Boolean with the missing numeric heartbeat definition honestly recorded in unresolved.

GTE_Perps_and_Launchpad.notes: The duplicate-predicate family survived every prompt round: p_malicious_user_creates_pair_first and assume_pair_created_before_graduation collapse onto one identical truth(pair_already_exists) predicate, so the temporal ordering fact stops being represented. Exposed by the report-only identical_p_predicates check; the dual review independently flags the same collapse.

GTE_Spot_CLOB_and_Router.notes: Bound constants 15 and 16 are report-text literals and each fact keeps its own predicate. Minor redundancy: two facts pin max_packable_index with ge 15 and eq 16; the dual review calls the eq 16 term a conflation (partial), the primary review accepts it as grounded per-fact encoding.

Hybra_Finance.notes: claimFees scope: I = (anyone calls, rewards held, reward token is a pool token) implies reward tokens sent to bribe == 0; V = the drain. Free of the fabricated-definition family that killed this project in live-1/live-3.

Intuition_2VUsxVJwReb.notes: Amount-level restatement of the time-weighted-lock fairness: attacker_reward_share <= honest_continuous_share with symbolic shares (numeric definitions absent, recorded in unresolved). The dual review rates I/V partial for narrowing to the attacker scenario; the primary review accepts the encoding with the narrowing disclosed in limitations.

Merkl_T4ExvutBBXC.engineering: rejected (solver consistency: safety infeasible under P)
Merkl_T4ExvutBBXC.notes: Correct consistency catch. The plan pins all four concrete balances in P (990, 1000, 1990, 2000 — all text literals), including the insolvency itself (liabilities 2000 > physical 1990), so P AND I is unsatisfiable: no safe model exists under an over-concretized P. The faithful shape keeps the deposit amounts in P and lets V carry liabilities > physical. Rejected rather than emitted — the intended behavior of the consistency tier.

Olas_j3PRAMM3fVq.notes: elapsed_time > 0 uses the text literal 0. I = (manipulated spot, tokens available, permissionless buyback) implies no execution at the manipulated price; the slippage bound is a free Boolean with missing numeric bounds recorded in unresolved. The dual review rates I/V partial for narrowing to the single incident.

Panoptic__Next_Core.engineering: rejected (solver consistency: P AND V infeasible)
Panoptic__Next_Core.notes: Correct consistency catch. P conjoins alternative scenario branches: position_in_range is pinned true (in-range high fee) and false (out-of-range low fee), and current_tick_manipulated false (spot determination) and true (manipulable) — P itself is unsatisfiable. The fee-evasion contrast needed one branch in P and the other in V. Rejected rather than emitted.

Sequence__Transaction_Rails.notes: Three distinct grounded P booleans (smart wallet, owner signature, recover returns owner); I = the context implies intent_accepted; V = the intents failing. Both reviews rate it clean; the project's live-4 no-change rejection did not recur.

SukukFi_syLyTBz5KNA.notes: The element layer admitted the requirement-comment statement ('Contract must not be paused') as a precondition; the formal layer encoded it as truth(must_not_be_paused_requirement) in P — a documentation requirement in P, which the prompt forbids. I = (paused, privileged flow invoked) implies funds not moved, V = funds moved while paused. The dual review additionally rates I/V partial for narrowing to the batch flows.
